azure.aks.backup.title: Azure Backup for AKS
limitations: Azure Backup for AKS (backup vault, backup extension, backup instances for a cluster) is not modelled; the Backup page shows an honest Not simulated panel.

azure.aks.tools.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks
limitations: Diagnose and solve problems is real: detectors (core/azure_diagnose_core.py) are computed from the resource's live configuration, child resources and recorded operations; there is no platform telemetry behind a simulator, so none reads invented metrics and there is no AI troubleshooter.

Tasks are real Logic App workflows (Recurrence trigger plus Http-to-ARM actions, core/azure_tasks_core.py): scheduled runs call the simulator's own ARM and keep results in the run output; only Recurrence triggers and Http/Compose actions run, there is no e-mail or Teams connector, and Nano only fires schedules while the tab is open.

azure.apim.capacity.title: Capacity gauge
limitations: The capacity gauge is not modelled: Vyomi has no gateway load to measure.

azure.apim.create_monitoring.title: Wiring a new service to Log Analytics, Application Insights or Defender for APIs at create time
limitations: These create-wizard checkboxes provision separate monitoring and security resources in real Azure; Vyomi does not model that provisioning (create the Log Analytics workspace / Application Insights component separately and link it from the service).

azure.cosmos.integrations.title: Azure Function, Power BI and Data Migration tool integrations
limitations: These integration pages (Azure Function trigger wizard, Power BI, Azure Data Migration Service) need separate Azure products that Vyomi does not run; the blade shows an honest Not simulated panel for each. Use Data Explorer and the native Cosmos SDK instead.

azure.cosmos.container_blades.title: Browse and Scale blades for a single container
limitations: The standalone Browse and Scale blades are not modelled: select the container in Data Explorer (azure.cosmos.data_explorer) and use account-level throughput (azure.cosmos.scale_ru) instead.

azure.entra.bitlocker_keys.title: BitLocker keys
limitations: BitLocker recovery key escrow needs real disk encryption on real hardware, which Vyomi's software simulation does not have.

azure.entra.toolbar_actions.title: Entra grid toolbar actions (bulk operations, per-user MFA, columns, export settings, preview features, troubleshoot, feedback)
limitations: Toolbar actions on the Entra user, group, application, role and device grids that are not modelled: inline bulk edit, CSV bulk operations, per-user MFA, Export Data Settings, Troubleshoot / Diagnose and solve problems, Columns, Download (Export), Preview features and info, and Got feedback. Delete custom role is available from the grid's Delete command.

Tasks are real Logic App workflows (Recurrence trigger plus Http-to-ARM actions, core/azure_tasks_core.py): scheduled runs call the simulator's own ARM and keep results in the run output; only Recurrence triggers and Http/Compose actions run, there is no e-mail or Teams connector, and Nano only fires schedules while the tab is open.

azure.keyvaults.deleted_objects.title: Manage deleted keys and secrets (recover / purge)
limitations: Soft-deleted keys and secrets are kept (with deletedDate and a 90-day scheduledPurgeDate) and can be listed, read, recovered or purged over the native /deletedkeys and /deletedsecrets REST. The retention clock is informational: nothing is purged automatically when scheduledPurgeDate passes, and re-creating a deleted name overwrites it instead of returning 409. Deleted certificates are not modelled.

azure.keyvaults.resource_access_flags.title: Enable access for VMs, ARM template deployment and disk encryption
limitations: The Access configuration blade stores enabledForDeployment, enabledForDiskEncryption and enabledForTemplateDeployment on the vault through ARM and reads them back; no VM, template-deployment or disk-encryption flow consults them, so the flags are configuration only.

azure.sql.integrations.title: Integrations (Stream Analytics, Data Sync, Fabric mirroring, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
limitations: These integration pages need separate Azure products (Stream Analytics, SQL Data Sync, Microsoft Fabric, the Power Platform) that Vyomi does not run; the blade shows an honest Not simulated panel for each.

azure.sql.database_watcher.title: Database watcher
limitations: Database watcher (Microsoft.DatabaseWatcher: continuous collection of database telemetry into Data Explorer) is not modelled.

azure.sql.tools.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, external SQL client
limitations: Diagnose and solve problems is real: detectors (core/azure_diagnose_core.py) are computed from the resource's live configuration, child resources and recorded operations; there is no platform telemetry behind a simulator, so none reads invented metrics and there is no AI troubleshooter. Available on the database blade.

Tasks are real Logic App workflows (Recurrence trigger plus Http-to-ARM actions, core/azure_tasks_core.py): scheduled runs call the simulator's own ARM and keep results in the run output; only Recurrence triggers and Http/Compose actions run, there is no e-mail or Teams connector, and Nano only fires schedules while the tab is open. Available on the database blade.
The external SQL client download pages are not modelled.

azure.sql.always_encrypted.title: Always Encrypted
limitations: Always Encrypted (column master keys and client-side column encryption) is not modelled; Transparent data encryption is a separate, real-as-config page (azure.sql.transparent_data_encryption).

azure.storage.private_endpoints.title: Private endpoint connections
limitations: Private endpoint connections on the storage account are not modelled in the Networking page (the Private Endpoint resource itself is a Network service object).

azure.resourcegroups.tools.title: Force delete, Resource group insights, Tasks
limitations: Force delete of VMs and scale sets inside a group, Resource group insights and Tasks (Azure Automation / Logic Apps) are not modelled; plain delete of the group and of its resources is real (azure.resourcegroups.rg.crud).

azure.acr.support_troubleshooting.title: Container Registry support and troubleshooting pages
limitations: Diagnose and solve problems is real: detectors (core/azure_diagnose_core.py) are computed from the resource's live configuration, child resources and recorded operations; there is no platform telemetry behind a simulator, so none reads invented metrics and there is no AI troubleshooter.
Registry Tasks (build tasks) are a separate real feature (azure.acr.tasks); the support request panel is the simulator's own.
